facts.fact: The ITU repository lists Digital Cameroon 2020 / National Digital Transformation Strategy as the country's strategy and says the countries it lists have adopted one; no adopting act is named, so this is dated by the repository's 2025 publication year.
The repository gives the time frame of Digital Cameroon 2020 / National Digital Transformation Strategy as 2016 - 2025.
The repository names MINPOSTEL as lead/owner of Digital Cameroon 2020 / National Digital Transformation Strategy.
